Harbor Opens New Research Pier

REQUIRED-NEWS-LEDE: Marine researchers opened a public observation pier on Tuesday after three years of construction.

REQUIRED-NEWS-QUOTE: The director said the facility will help students collect long-term measurements without disrupting coastal habitats.

REQUIRED-NEWS-CONTEXT: The project includes weather sensors, accessible walkways, and a small classroom used by local schools.
